name: Cinteric 5% – Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
description: Cinteric 5% Anti-Dandruff Shampoo is the stronger formulation in the Cinteric hair care range, recommended for persistent or severe dandruff. The elevated 5% concentration provides more intensive scalp treatment for stubborn cases.
usage: Wet hair thoroughly. Apply to scalp and massage for 3–5 minutes. Leave on for 5 minutes before rinsing. Use 2 times per week initially, then reduce as condition improves.

name: Soap – Antiseptic Skin Rejuvenating
description: A medically-formulated antiseptic soap that combines deep cleansing with skin-renewing properties. Effective against bacteria while being gentle enough for regular use on face and body.
usage: Lather with water and apply to skin. Massage gently for 30 seconds. Rinse thoroughly. Use twice daily.

name: Cinteric Gel – Anti Acne Gel
description: Cinteric Gel is a clinically-informed anti-acne formulation developed to target active breakouts, reduce inflammation, and prevent future blemishes. Recommended by Dr. Jayaruwan Bandara as part of a comprehensive acne care routine.
usage: Cleanse face thoroughly. Apply a small amount directly onto affected areas. Use twice daily, morning and evening. Follow with sunscreen during the day.

name: Leonor – Body Lotion
description: Leonor Body Lotion is a richly formulated moisturiser designed to hydrate and soften skin with every application. Ideal for daily use, it absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue, leaving skin feeling supple and refreshed.
usage: Apply generously to clean, dry skin after bathing. Massage in circular motions until fully absorbed. Use daily for best results.

name: Cinteric 4 Step – Acne Face Cleanser
description: A comprehensive acne-fighting cleanser system that guides you through a complete cleansing routine. The Cinteric 4 Step system targets acne at multiple stages, removing impurities, targeting bacteria, and restoring skin balance.
usage: Follow the 4-step instructions included with the product. Use morning and evening for best results. Always follow with Cinteric 90+ sunscreen in the daytime.

name: Cinteric 3% – Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
description: Cinteric 3% Anti-Dandruff Shampoo is a medicated hair care formulation that targets dandruff at the scalp level. The 3% active concentration is suited for mild to moderate dandruff and general scalp health maintenance.
usage: Wet hair thoroughly. Apply shampoo and massage into scalp for 2–3 minutes. Leave on for 3–5 minutes before rinsing. Use 2–3 times per week.

name: Cinteric 90+ – Sunscreen Gel
description: Cinteric 90+ is a broad-spectrum SPF sunscreen gel formulated specifically for the Sri Lankan climate. It provides high UV protection while maintaining a lightweight, non-sticky feel, essential daily protection in Colombo's equatorial sun.
usage: Apply generously to all exposed areas 20 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2–3 hours when outdoors. Use as the final step in your morning skincare routine.
